suites.title: DQ-2 Personal book collection - browse the catalogue and manage my books

specs.title: SCN-001: The catalogue API returns every book with all catalogue fields

steps.title: When I GET /BookStore/v1/Books
Then the response status is 200
And the body has a books list
And every entry in books carries isbn, title, subTitle, author, publish_date, publisher, pages, description and website

specs.title: SCN-002: Every catalogue entry has the field types of the Book object

steps.title: When I GET /BookStore/v1/Books
Then every entry's isbn, title, subTitle, author, publisher, description and website are strings, pages is a number and publish_date is an ISO-8601 string

specs.title: SCN-003.1: Looking up one book returns the same data as its catalogue entry (9781449325862)

steps.title: Given I read the catalogue entry for 9781449325862 from GET /BookStore/v1/Books
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
When I GET /BookStore/v1/Book?ISBN=9781449325862
Then the response status is 200
And the returned book equals the catalogue entry

specs.title: SCN-004: The Book Store page lists every catalogue book with title, author and publisher

steps.title: Given I read the catalogue from GET /BookStore/v1/Books
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
And I am on the Book Store page /books
Then every catalogue book is listed on the page
And each listed book shows its title, author and publisher

specs.title: SCN-005.1: Searching filters the list while typing, case-insensitively (javascript)

steps.title: Given I am on the Book Store page /books
When I type "javascript" into the search box with placeholder "Type to search" without submitting
Then exactly the books Learning JavaScript Design Patterns; Speaking JavaScript; Programming JavaScript Applications; Eloquent JavaScript, Second Edition are listed

specs.title: SCN-006: A search term that matches no book leaves no book rows

steps.title: Given I am on the Book Store page /books
When I type a term that matches no book into the search box with placeholder "Type to search"
Then no book rows are listed

specs.title: SCN-007: Clicking a book title opens its detail page with the catalogue values

steps.title: Given I read the catalogue entry for 9781449325862 from GET /BookStore/v1/Books
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
And I am on the Book Store page /books
When I click the title "Git Pocket Guide"
Then the book's detail page shows its ISBN, title, sub title, author, publisher and total pages as in the catalogue

specs.title: SCN-008: Adding books to my collection returns 201, echoes the ISBNs and lists them on my account

steps.title: Given I created my own user and obtained a token
[SEED] my user (POST /Account/v1/User + POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
When I POST /BookStore/v1/Books with ISBNs 9781449325862 and 9781593277574
Then the response status is 201
And the response books list exactly the added ISBNs
And GET /Account/v1/User/{UUID} lists both books in my books

specs.title: SCN-009: A book added through the API appears on the Profile page after signing in

steps.title: Given I created my own user and obtained a token
[SEED] my user (POST /Account/v1/User + POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
And I added 9781449325862 to my collection through the API
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
[SEED] add 9781449325862 to my collection (POST /BookStore/v1/Books)
And I am on the sign-in page /login
When I sign in with my user name and password
Then the Profile page lists the book with its title, author and publisher

specs.title: SCN-010: Adding a book already in my collection is rejected and the book stays once

steps.title: Given I created my own user and obtained a token
[SEED] my user (POST /Account/v1/User + POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
And I added 9781449325862 to my collection through the API
[SEED] add 9781449325862 to my collection (POST /BookStore/v1/Books)
When I POST /BookStore/v1/Books with 9781449325862 again
Then the response status is 400
And the error is code "1210" with message "ISBN already present in the User's Collection!"
And GET /Account/v1/User/{UUID} lists 9781449325862 exactly once

specs.title: SCN-012: Deleting one book through the API returns 204 and keeps the others

steps.title: Given I created my own user and obtained a token
[SEED] my user (POST /Account/v1/User + POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
And I added 9781449325862 and 9781593277574 to my collection through the API
[SEED] add 9781449325862, 9781593277574 to my collection (POST /BookStore/v1/Books)
When I DELETE /BookStore/v1/Book with 9781449325862
Then the response status is 204
And GET /Account/v1/User/{UUID} no longer lists 9781449325862 and still lists 9781593277574

specs.title: SCN-013: Deleting a book that is not in my collection is rejected

steps.title: Given I created my own user and obtained a token
[SEED] my user (POST /Account/v1/User + POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
And I added 9781593277574 to my collection through the API
[SEED] add 9781593277574 to my collection (POST /BookStore/v1/Books)
When I DELETE /BookStore/v1/Book with 9781449325862, which is not in my collection
Then the response status is 400
And the error is code "1206" with message "ISBN supplied is not available in User's Collection!"

specs.title: SCN-014: Looking up an ISBN that is not in the catalogue is rejected

steps.title: Given an ISBN that is not in the catalogue returned by GET /BookStore/v1/Books
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
When I GET /BookStore/v1/Book?ISBN=<that ISBN>
Then the response status is 400
And the error is code "1205" with message "ISBN supplied is not available in Books Collection!"

specs.title: SCN-015: Adding an ISBN that is not in the catalogue is rejected and nothing is added

steps.title: Given I created my own user and obtained a token
[SEED] my user (POST /Account/v1/User + POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
And an ISBN that is not in the catalogue returned by GET /BookStore/v1/Books
[SEED] read the catalogue (GET /BookStore/v1/Books)
When I POST /BookStore/v1/Books with that ISBN
Then the response status is 400
And the error is code "1205" with message "ISBN supplied is not available in Books Collection!"
And GET /Account/v1/User/{UUID} shows my collection is still empty

specs.title: SCN-016.1: Collection calls without a valid token are refused (POST /BookStore/v1/Books for my user without a token)

steps.title: Given I created my own user and obtained a token
[SEED] my user (POST /Account/v1/User + POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
And another user exists
[SEED] other user (POST /Account/v1/User + POST /Account/v1/GenerateToken)
When I call POST /BookStore/v1/Books for my user without a token
Then the response status is 401
And the error is code "1200" with message "User not authorized!"
